sentence: This project builds a computational framework that translates structural designs from nature into engineering practice using artificial intelligence and additive manufacturing.
This project builds a software platform that uses machine learning to automate the creation of material behavior models for polymers used in 3D printing.
This project studies how warm climate grasses protect their leaves from damage in cold by harmlessly releasing extra energy, using Miscanthus.
This project builds an online research platform with a web system, datasets and machines to help understand cybersecurity threats to smart manufacturing.
This project develops statistical methods that reduce noise in large noisy datasets while keeping the essential features of the signal.
This project studies which genes let plants like broccoli, capers and wasabi make many different chemical compounds called glucosinolates.
This project builds a robotic factory that designs, 3D prints and tests soft actuators powered by pressurized air, recycling parts that fail.
This project gets a brain imaging instrument that records the timing of brain activity to study memory, sleep and how the brains of children develop.
This project studies the timing of autumn change in local campus trees and builds tools to collect and compare tree data.
This project tests several ways to measure isotopes in seafloor sediments to work out the age of Arctic seafloor sediments.
This project builds a framework for Security Operation Centers that adds automation to security work and measures the role of human analysts.
This project studies how human stem cells add up the amount of a cell signal over time to decide which type of cell to become.
This project uses deep learning to find security vulnerabilities in Internet of Things devices by analyzing digital forensic evidence.
This project builds a framework for trusted resource allocation, so scientists can safely run workflows on computers shared by volunteers.
This project builds robots that teach people motor skills by adapting the tasks and help they give to each learner.
This project uses artificial intelligence to predict the structure of biomolecules and to design new biomolecules.
